start.text: (On the phone, in the accent of a town three hours from yours.) — No, Amma, stipend is coming, they said processing — I'll call. (He hangs up.) Sorry. You also new? Which town?

choices.text: Not far from yours, by the sound of it.
New since Monday. You work here?

town.text: Ha! I knew it. Ravi. Intern — not here, at a lab in Hebbal. HIVR. Shuttle picks us up from this gate, God knows why. Two months and the stipend is still 'processing'.

lab.text: Not here. Lab in Hebbal — HIVR, you'd have seen the name on cold boxes at the airport. Shuttle picks us up from this gate. Two months, no stipend. 'Processing'.

number.text: Take my number. Call anytime — I'm free. Too free. (A white van turns in. The same blue-cross box logo as the airport, on its door.) That's me. Monday, same time?

again.text: Shuttle's late again. Stipend's late again. I'm early for everything, that's my problem.

night.text: (Ravi, hood up, on the shuttle-bay bench under the one light that still works. The whole park is dark; a generator hums somewhere behind the gate.) You came. I didn't think... sorry. Sorry for messaging so late.

night_2.text: Thirty hours. They put me on the agri-samples alone — the senior went home at six. 'You can manage, no?' I managed. I don't know if I managed.

night_3.text: Akka's wedding is in March. The loan is in my name — three lakh. First instalment is Friday, and the stipend is still 'processing'.

night_4.text: And Appa calls. Always at the worst time. In the corridor, gloves on, the phone buzzing in my pocket... I can't not pick up. He's alone at home.

choice.text: (He's shaking. The first shuttle back to Hebbal is at two-thirty.)

choices.text: I'll sit with you till the shuttle comes.
I have work tomorrow, Ravi. Get some sleep.

sat.text: (You sit. An hour goes. He talks about the village, the mango tree, the cricket bat his father carved for him. The shaking slows.)

choices.text: The shuttle's here. Go home, Ravi.

paid.text: No. No, no — (He refuses twice. Then he takes it, hands shaking, and holds it like it might fly away.) I'll pay you back. After the processing.

choices.text: I'll sit with you till the shuttle comes.

bye.text: (The shuttle's headlights swing in. He gets on and waves once from the window.) Message me when you reach. I mean it.

left.text: (He nods too fast.) Yeah. Yeah, of course. Sorry. Go, go. (At the auto stand you look back. He's still on the bench.)

after_night.text: (Ravi nods at you across the shuttle bay. Neither of you mentions that night.)
